title: SoFi Stock News (Oct 16, 2026): SOFI Rises 6.1% to $15.09
summary: SoFi (SOFI) closed at $15.09 on Oct 15, 2026, up 6.12%, reversing off a 52-week low of $13.86 on volume 39.6% above average.
body_markdown:
## Why SoFi Stock Rose


No fetched source names a company-specific reason for Thursday's gain, and SoFi issued no new release tied to the move. According to[Schaeffer's Investment Research](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sofi-rally-could-dead-cat-180031924.html) , SoFi was "exempt from the AI struggles" weighing on parts of the market on October 15, hitting its 52-week low of $13.86 early in the session before reversing higher. The firm noted the stock was still down 44.3% year to date.


The rebound followed a heavy Wednesday. As reported by[Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-did-sofi-plug-asts-042608638.html) , SoFi posted its steepest single-day drop since July on October 14 after Goldman Sachs revised its view on the stock. The same report cited broader macroeconomic pressure, weakness in the banking sector and a recent increase in benchmark interest rates as headwinds.


Per[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/sofi-technologies-imploded-2026-wall-144522917.html) , StoneX analyst Mark Palmer said the shares "lagged because its earnings didn't keep up with its revenue growth in the first half of 2026."


## SOFI Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Second-quarter 2026 revenue came in at $1.22 billion, 8.24% above estimates, and full-year adjusted net revenue guidance was raised to $4.75 billion to $4.85 billion, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- Loan originations hit a record of about $14.80 billion, up 69%, with deposits at $45.5 billion, per the same report.
- Personal loan charge-offs improved to 2.62% from 2.83%, a sign of steadier credit quality in the quarter.


### Risks


- Technology Platform revenue fell 23% after a large client left, and management now assumes a 22% tax rate, roughly 700 basis points above its original plan, according to 24/7 Wall St.
- Short interest rose 21% over the two most recent reporting periods as the stock weakened, Schaeffer's reported.
- Stocktwits pointed to rising benchmark interest rates and banking-sector weakness as continuing pressure on the company.
